FROM sb.carries c
JOIN sb.events e ON c.event_id = e.event_id
JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE e.period < 5

GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_distance DESC

WITH fouls_per_team_match AS (
  SELECT 
    e.team_id,
    e.match_id,
    COUNT(*) as fouls_count
  FROM sb.events e
  WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed'
    AND e.period IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
  GROUP BY e.team_id, e.match_id
),
avg_fouls_per_team AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fpm.match_id) as matches_count,
    ROUND(AVG(fpm.fouls_count)::numeric, 2) as avg_fouls_per_match
  FROM fouls_per_team_match fpm
  JOIN sb.teams t ON fpm.team_id = t.team_id
  GROUP BY t.team_name
)
SELECT 
  team_name,
  avg_fouls_per_match
FROM avg_fouls_per_team
ORDER BY avg_fouls_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT 
  p.player_name,
  t.team_name,
  m.match_date,
  CASE 
    WHEN e.type = 'Foul Committed' THEN (e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name')
    WHEN e.type = 'Bad Behaviour' THEN (e.details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name')
  END as card_type
FROM sb.events e
JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE (
  (e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND (e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name') IN ('Red Card', 'Second Yellow'))
  OR (e.type = 'Bad Behaviour' AND (e.details -> 'bad_behaviour' -> 'card' ->> 'name') IN ('Red Card', 'Second Yellow'))
)
AND e.period <= 4
ORDER BY m.match_date, p.player_name;

SELECT

FROM sb.matches m
JOIN sb.teams t1 ON m.home_team_id = t1.team_id
JOIN sb.teams t2 ON m.away_team_id = t2.team_id
WHERE (m.home_score + m.away_score) = (SELECT MAX(home_score + away_score) FROM sb.matches)
ORDER BY m.match_date;

WITH france_lineups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    jsonb_array_elements(e.details -> 'tactics' -> 'lineup') -> 'player' ->> 'name' AS player_name
  FROM sb.events e
  JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE e.type = 'Starting XI'
    AND (m.home_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France')
         OR m.away_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France'))
    AND e.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_joueurs
FROM france_lineups

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN home_score > away_score THEN (SELECT team_name FROM sb.teams WHERE team_id = m.home_team_id)
    WHEN away_score > home_score THEN (SELECT team_name FROM sb.teams WHERE team_id = m.away_team_id)
  END AS winner,
  home_score,
  away_score
FROM sb.matches m
WHERE stage = 'Final'

WITH penalty_winners AS (
  SELECT 
    m.match_id,
    t.team_name,
    COUNT(*) as penalty_goals
  FROM sb.events e
  JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN sb.shots s ON e.event_id = s.event_id
  JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id
  WHERE e.period = 5 AND e.type = 'Shot' AND s.outcome = 'Goal'
  GROUP BY m.match_id, t.team_name
),
match_results AS (
  SELECT 
    m.match_id,
    t_home.team_name as home_team,
    t_away.team_name as away_team,
    COALESCE((SELECT penalty_goals FROM penalty_winners WHERE match_id = m.match_id AND team_name = t_home.team_name), 0) as home_goals,
    COALESCE((SELECT penalty_goals FROM penalty_winners WHERE match_id = m.match_id AND team_name = t_away.team_name), 0) as away_goals
  FROM sb.matches m
  JOIN sb.teams t_home ON m.home_team_id = t_home.team_id
  JOIN sb.teams t_away ON m.away_team_id = t_away.team_id
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sb.events e WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND e.period = 5
  )
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN home_goals > away_goals THEN home_team
    ELSE away_team
  END as team,
  COUNT(*) as penalty_shootout_wins
FROM match_results
GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN home_goals > away_goals THEN home_team
    ELSE away_team
  END
ORDER BY penalty_shootout_wins DESC, team
